name: Laughing Mad
oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a card.
Draw two cards.
Flashback {3}{R} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost and any additional costs. Then exile it.)
blocked_sentences: As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a card.
Flashback {3}{R} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost and any additional costs. Then exile it.)

needs.what: a card-level `additional_cost` that is charged on every way of casting the spell, not only from hand -- specifically on the flashback (and other alternative-cost / non-hand) cast lines, so that a mandatory additional cost is owed by the graveyard cast too (601.2f)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `additional_cost` is the right slot and `cost_keys.discard` is the right price, but legality only offers additional-cost cast variants under `state.objects[oid].zone is Zone.HAND`, and the flashback line is built by calling `_cast_variant(..., flashback=True)` directly from the graveyard loop, bypassing the `_cast_options` block that sets `additional_times`. `game._cast` pays the non-mana half only when `action.additional_times` is nonzero, so a flashed-back Laughing Mad would cost {3}{R} and discard nothing -- a strictly-better free draw-two, which is exactly the quiet wrongness the printed reminder 'and any additional costs' rules out. Moving the discard into `spell_effects` as the `discard` op is not a substitute: that pays at resolution rather than as a cost, and lets the spell be cast when the price could not be paid.
